map.用 EV 分级判断环境（晴天下雪到月光夜景），辅助外拍布光与测光表校验。: Use EV levels to judge the environment (from bright sun on snow to moonlit night), assisting with outdoor lighting and meter checks.
map.EV100 = log2(N² / t)（N 为光圈 F 值、t 为快门秒数）；: EV100 = log2(N² / t) (N is the aperture f-number and t the shutter time in seconds); including sensitivity, EV = EV100 + log2(ISO / 100). Scene levels: ≥15 snow and beach, ≥13 bright sun, ≥11 overcast or sunny shade, ≥9 overcast or bright indoor, ≥7 ordinary indoor light, ≥5 dusk or dim indoor, ≥3 night street lighting, ≥1 moonlight, <1 extremely dark.
map.f/8、1/250 s（t=0.004）、ISO 100：EV100 = log: f/8, 1/250 s (t=0.004), ISO 100: EV100 = log2(8²/0.004) = log2(16000) ≈ 13.97 → about EV 14, which is 'bright sun'. At ISO 400: EV = 13.97 + log2(4) = 15.97, so the same combination maps to a brighter scene at high sensitivity.
map.ISO 不改变实际进光量，但改变“达到合适曝光所需的亮度”。公式中 EV 随 I: ISO does not change how much light actually enters, but it changes 'the brightness needed for a correct exposure'. In the formula EV rises with ISO, meaning the same exposure settings can be used in darker environments at the cost of more noise.
map.EV 不变时，开大一档光圈（进光加倍）需把快门时间减半，反之亦然；例如 f/8: At constant EV, opening the aperture one stop (doubling the light) requires halving the shutter time, and vice versa; for example f/8 1/250s and f/5.6 1/500s are equivalent in exposure (with different depth of field).
